result.text: In treatment-naive patients, confirmed ORR 70% (95% CI 50, 86) with median DOR 9.0 months (95% CI 6.3, NE). In previously platinum-treated patients, confirmed ORR 57% (95% CI 46, 68) with median DOR not estimable (95% CI 15.2, NE).

citations.quote: The confirmed overall response rate (ORR) assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) in treatment-naïve patients was 70% (95% CI: 50, 86) and the median duration of response was 9.0 months (95% CI: 6.3, not estimable [NE]), with 58% of the 19 responders having observed DOR of ≥ 6 months. In the previously platinum-treated population, the confirmed ORR per BICR was 57% (95% CI: 46, 68) and the median duration of response was not estimable (95% CI: 15.2, NE), with 80% of the 50 responders having observed DOR of ≥ 6 months.
